inputs.name: categories
inputs.purpose: The names of the categories in this AlignedDynamicTable. Each category is represented by one DynamicTable stored in the parent group. This attribute should be used to specify an order of categories and the category names must match the names of the corresponding DynamicTable in the group.

inputs.purpose: The shape (number of rows, number of columns) of this sparse matrix.
